spruce noun

the tree

also spruce tree, Norway spruce, pitch-pine

classical

Verg. G. 2.257 (Lewis & Short)
Ov. Met. 10.101 (Lewis & Short)
Plin. NH 16.40 (Lewis & Short)

picea, piceae f.

noun, first declension

a resinous conifer: spruce or pitch-pine

From pix, pitch: the tree that gives it. The identification is uncertain: Lewis & Short makes it the pitch-pine (Scots pine), while botanists since Linnaeus give the name Picea to the spruces. Pliny (NH 16.40) tells it apart from abiēs and pīnus.

See also tree, fir, pine, larch, resin.
